name: [TIGER SHARK]🌴 monkey raft 🌴
desc:
a roguelike boat building adventure set on the prehistoric Atlantic Ocean

you follow a group of primates cast from their peaceful treetop home into the hands of the stormy blue..
will you survive, and found a new lineage in a new world?
or will you perish in the deep?

⛵️build a raft
🦈fight giant sharks
🍔cook
🌴swing on vines
and 🐒EVOLVE🐒to reach a new world!
